baseline_reason: adoption: the integration commit the rail was built on (lp/wave5 00d907d4). Only commits that descend from the baseline are judged; work merged in from a branch that has not merged the rail is inherited and listed, not judged. A move of this value is the captain's call and is recorded here with its reason and what it stops re-checking.

exemptions.reason: upstream's module note for the self-updater, inherited from the fork; its claims (Windows MSI staging, the backend sha256 check, the 15 s watchdog) describe the upstream updater and were not verified against Lampway, whose server answers update_available false. Converting it to an AGENTS.md contract needs a read of core/install_flow.py by the lane that owns updates; until then it is recorded here, not rewritten unverified.
